title: corydalis heterocarpa var. koidzumiana
intro: Corydalis heterocarpa var. koidzumiana, commonly known as  'Yamabe's corydalis', is a plant species belonging to the Corydalis genus, which is native to East Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine for its various health benefits, including its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis heterocarpa var. koidzumiana include pain relief, fever reduction, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, such as berberine, and other compounds that have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
